contract: Original project .planning artifacts are source of truth: bounded allowlisted document/phase reads and SHA-guarded edits. Explicit phase plan/execute/verify creates a real OPEN task in the project GSD list, deduplicates pending requests and never claims execution or promotes documents into runtime instructions.
acceptance: Read actual bound project planning documents and phase PLAN/SUMMARY evidence without inferring completion.
Edit original document with observed SHA, preserve unrelated source, reject stale writes/path escapes/invalid content and reload after source change.
Create real NativeTaskProvider open phase tasks under actual project GSD task list; repeated open action resolves same task across reads.
Console edits source and creates tasks through real HTTP; native read/request tools use actual actor context and no stubs.

limitations: Phase actions create real open work requests; no external GSD execution is claimed.
